title: Kundalini Curios Clock
description: A surreal painting features a large ornate clock with Roman numerals and a blue snake coiled around its frame. The clock face contains three stylized women with red and blue afros, while a giant iridescent beetle carries three more women below. Smoke forms an infinity symbol rising from the scene against a twilight city skyline.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene with a large blue snake coiled around an ornate clock with Roman numerals. Inside the clock are three women with vibrant red and blue afros. Below, a large iridescent green beetle carries three more women with colorful afros. Smoke forms an infinity symbol rising into a purple twilight sky with a crescent moon, city skyline, and a tree with white blossoms. A small table holds an open book titled 'Timeless' and a bell. Mystical, psychedelic, vibrant color palette.
